Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book The Old Man and the Sea. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".
(A) Ernest Hemingway's *The Old Man and the Sea* tells the story of an aging Cuban fisherman, Santiago, who struggles with a giant marlin far out at sea, ultimately losing the fish to sharks but returning home with dignity and renewed respect. 
(B) W.G. Sebald's *Austerlitz* is a haunting and fragmented novel narrated by an unnamed narrator who becomes fascinated by a quiet, elderly man named Jacques Austerlitz. Through a series7 of encounters and conversations, Austerlitz slowly reveals his deeply traumatic past as a Jewish child sent to a British boarding school as part of a post-war child migration program. The novel explores themes of memory, loss, displacement, and the lingering effects of historical trauma, weaving together Austerlitz's personal recollections with reflections on architecture, photography, and the fragility of history itself. Ultimately, *Austerlitz* is a profound meditation on the difficulty of confronting the past and the enduring power of silence and absence.
(C) Ernest Hemingway's *The Old Man and the Sea* tells the story of Santiago, an aging Cuban fisherman who has gone 84 days without catching a fish. Determined to prove his skill and restore his reputation, he ventures far out into the Gulf Stream and hooks a magnificent marlin, larger than his boat. A grueling, days-long battle ensues, testing Santiago's physical and mental endurance as he struggles to subdue the giant fish. Though he ultimately triumphs in landing the marlin, sharks relentlessly devour it on his journey back to shore, leaving him with only a skeleton and a profound sense of loss, yet also a quiet dignity and renewed respect for the power of nature and the enduring spirit of man.
(D) W.G. Sebald's *Austerlitz* is a haunting and fragmented memoir exploring the life of Jacques Austerlitz, a man of uncertain origins who grapples with repressed memories of his childhood in pre-war Czechoslovakia and his experiences as a child refugee in England, ultimately confronting the devastating legacy of the Holocaust.
C

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book The Great Gatsby. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".
(A) "Hullabaloo in the Guava Orchard" by K.T. Patel tells the charming story of Rajiv, a shy and awkward boy living in Kenya, who is desperate to impress the beautiful and popular Puja. When a mysterious thief begins stealing mangoes from the local orchard, Rajiv seizes the opportunity to become a detective, believing solving the case will win him Puja's affection. His investigation leads him and his friends on a hilarious and chaotic adventure filled with mistaken identities, comical mishaps, and ultimately, a surprising discovery about the true nature of the "thief" and himself. It's a heartwarming tale about growing up, friendship, and finding courage in unexpected places. 
(B) F. Scott Fitzgerald's *The Great Gatsby* is a tragic love story set in the roaring twenties on Long Island, New York. Narrated by Nick Carraway, the novel follows the enigmatic millionaire Jay Gatsby and his relentless pursuit of the wealthy and married Daisy Buchanan. Gatsby throws lavish parties in hopes of attracting Daisy's attention, fueled by a five-year-old dream of recapturing their lost romance. However, the illusion of Gatsby's wealth and the unattainable nature of the past ultimately lead to devastating consequences, exposing the dark underbelly of the American Dream and the destructive power of class, wealth, and illusion.
(C) The Great Gatsby is a tragic love story about a mysterious millionaire, Jay Gatsby, who throws lavish parties in the hopes of winning back his former love, Daisy Buchanan, ultimately revealing the destructive nature of the American Dream and the illusion of wealth and status.

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book Of Mice and Men. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".

Initially a source of frustration for the stern Marilla, Anne's vibrant personality and unwavering optimism gradually win her over, and she blossoms into a beloved member of the community. The novel follows Anne's journey through childhood and adolescence as she navigates school, friendships (particularly with her rival-turned-best friend Diana Barry), and the challenges of growing up, all while embracing the beauty and wonder of her new home at Green Gables.

George, a sharp and protective man, cares for Lennie, a large and mentally disabled man with immense physical strength but limited understanding. They find work on a ranch in California, hoping to earn enough money for their dream, but Lennie's unintentional acts of violence, stemming from his love of soft things, repeatedly jeopardize their plans. Ultimately, to protect Lennie from the consequences of his actions and the cruelty of the world, George is forced to make a heartbreaking decision, shattering their shared dream and highlighting the harsh realities of the American Dream and the vulnerability of the marginalized.

B

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book The Pearl. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".
(A) A laconic Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver finds himself embroiled in a dangerous underworld when he agrees to help his neighbor's husband during a heist.

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book Heart of Darkness. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book Lord of the Flies. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".

Through Shukhov's quiet resilience and focus on small victories, like securing extra soup or a warm corner, the book offers a stark and unflinching portrayal of the dehumanizing effects of the Soviet gulag system while simultaneously celebrating the enduring strength of the human spirit.

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book Brave New World. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book 1984. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".

Please identify the correct one sentence summary of the book The Time Machine. Please respond with only "A", "B", "C", or "D".
